name: RAIC Eastern Regional Open Data Centre, Kenema
developer: Right to Access Information Commission (RAIC) Sierra Leone
notes: Public open-data/resource centre at RAIC Eastern Regional Office in Kenema City; source says regional data resource centers were furnished with reading materials, computers and internet facilities. Not a commercial colocation or hyperscale data center.

name: RAIC Northern Regional Open Data Centre, Makeni
developer: Right to Access Information Commission (RAIC) Sierra Leone
notes: Public open-data/resource centre in the Northern provincial headquarters city of Makeni; World Bank supported regional Open Data Centre operations. Not a commercial colocation or hyperscale data center.

name: RAIC Southern Regional Open Data Centre, Bo
developer: Right to Access Information Commission (RAIC) Sierra Leone
notes: Public open-data/resource centre in Bo; source identifies Bo as the Southern provincial headquarters city hosting a regional Open Data Centre. Not a commercial colocation or hyperscale data center.

name: Orange Sierra Leone Bo Data Centre
notes: President officially opened Orange's Bo City disaster-recovery data centre on 2025-11-29; reported as a EUR23m facility and the country's second Orange facility after Freetown.

name: Africell Data Centre at Tech and Innovation City, Tikonko/Bo District
developer: Africell Sierra Leone; Ministry of Communication, Technology and Innovation
notes: Africell committed under an MoU to build and operate a data centre in the planned 130-acre Tech City/Special Economic Zone in Tikonko Chiefdom, Bo District; sources say it would be open to third parties. No construction completion found.

name: RAIC Western Region Data Resource Centre, Freetown
developer: Right to Access Information Commission (RAIC) Sierra Leone
notes: RAIC Western Region unveiled a public data resource center at 46 Kroo Town Road, Freetown on 2019-12-12; later RAIC reporting describes Sierra Leone's open data centre/open data portal as a government-information hub. Not a commercial colocation or hyperscale data center.

name: Orange Sierra Leone Freetown Data Centre
notes: DCD reports Orange's primary Freetown facility launched in 2018 after a 2016 groundbreaking; 940 sqm site with 350 sqm white space and capacity for 154 racks.

name: Africell Freetown Data Center
notes: DCD reported seafront construction had begun in Freetown; facility intended first as Africell's disaster recovery center and later to host third-party infrastructure/data and possibly a second subsea cable. No later operational confirmation found.

name: Zoodlabs Data Centre / Cable Landing Station Power Project, Freetown
notes: CrossBoundary Energy lists a Zoodlabs Data Centre in Sierra Leone, powering Zoodlabs' Freetown data centre/cable landing and metro fibre infrastructure with 0.8 MWp solar, 0.7 MW thermal generation, and 1.95 MWh storage; commission date Q2 2023. Capacity_mw left null because power system rating is not stated as IT load.

name: Afcom Data Center & Colocation, Freetown
notes: Afcom's company page advertises its Sierra Leone-owned data center and colocation service; site footer gives 28B Beach Road, Freetown. No capacity or launch date disclosed.

name: SMART Sierra Leone National Data Centers
developer: Government of Sierra Leone; China National Technical Import & Export Corporation
notes: US$50m SMART Sierra Leone agreement includes establishing national data centers to manage/protect sovereign data and enhancing security around critical state infrastructure in Freetown; exact sites and capacities not disclosed, so assigned to Western Area due the Freetown infrastructure reference.
